definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture with doors and shelves used for storing dishes, food, or other household items.

examples.japanese: {食器|しょっき}は{戸棚|とだな}に{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please put the dishes in the cupboard.

examples.japanese: {戸棚|とだな}の{上|うえ}の{棚|たな}に{手|て}が{届|とど}かない。
examples.english: I can't reach the top shelf of the cupboard.

examples.japanese: {台所|だいどころ}の{戸棚|とだな}を{整理|せいり}した。

notes:
TYPES OF STORAGE FURNITURE:
- {戸棚|とだな} - cupboard with doors (general)
- {食器棚|しょっきだな} - dish cupboard
- {本棚|ほんだな} - bookshelf
- {棚|たな} - shelf (open)
- {タンス} - chest of drawers (for clothes)
- {押入れ|おしいれ} - Japanese-style closet

ETYMOLOGY: {戸|と} (door) + {棚|たな} (shelf) = shelves with doors

COMMON USAGE:
- {台所|だいどころ}の{戸棚|とだな} (kitchen cupboard)
- {戸棚|とだな}にしまう (to put away in the cupboard)
